build_GovReport: build a GovReport dataset builder to download and generate government report summaries in multiple styles
create_GovReportConfig: create a GovReportConfig with subset, style, and supervised keys for CRS or GAO report data
summarize_GovReport: summarize government reports by yielding examples with report text and summary from train, validation, or test splits
run__flatten_structure: run _flatten_structure to recursively flatten nested report sections into a single text string with optional HTML tags
test_GovReport: test GovReport dataset builder by generating examples from downloaded JSON files for CRS and GAO subsets
